content: Table 4 reports the precision, recall and F1 achieved both with and without sentence re-weighting. Re-weighting improves all metrics modestly but consistently. All F1 differences are statistically significant under a sign test ( $p<0.01$ ). The model with best precision is different for Patient, Intervention and Outcome labels. However re-weighting by difficulty does consistently yield the best recall for all three extraction types, with the most notable improvement for i and o, where recall improved by 10 percentage points. This performance increase translated to improvements in F1 across all types, as compared to the base model and to re-weighting by agreement.
